# Generated Chroma Segment

This UUID-named directory is an internal Chroma/HNSW segment containing binary index files such as `data_level0.bin`, `header.bin`, `length.bin`, link lists, and metadata.

**Do not edit these files manually.** They are generated and managed by Chroma. If the index must be refreshed, rebuild the parent control-to-CVE index through the application pipeline.
